notes: Custom PHP catalogue (index.php?module=cat&cat_id=N). No listing page anywhere on the site displays a product total, so every qty is derived from the sites own pager: page size is a fixed 30 products, so total = 30*(lastPage-1) + products on the last page. The pager always renders the true last page number, and requesting lastPage+1 clamps to the same final page, which was verified for every row. The formula was cross-checked against full enumeration (union of unique prod_id links across all pages) for cat_id 39, 370, 460 and 664 - all four matched exactly. Excluded per brief: ceiling fans (cat 6), bulbs (72), dimmers/controls/transformers/drivers and LED strip-tape (73/74/75/181/33), track, monorail, kable and recessed architectural systems, bathroom lighting (4), commercial lighting (432), furniture/storage/rugs/hardware (487/488/573/651/656/661), and Clocks & Watches (431). Note: several duplicate cat_ids exist that render only 30 products with no pager (e.g. 603, 154, 155, 156, 504, 507); the canonical primary cat_id was used in each case.
